blocks.heading: Brian Marktwian Clemens
blocks.bodyHtml:
Our co-owner and CEO is the driving force behind our company's vision and strategic direction. With a passion for innovation and a sharp focus on growth, he/she leads the company with integrity and decisiveness. As a co-owner, the CEO brings not only management experience, but also a personal investment in the company's success, ensuring dedication and commitment to achieving our goals. The CEO is a strategic thinker who combines deep business understanding with the ability to build strong relationships, both internally and externally. With this combination, we ensure solid leadership and a future full of opportunities. “Leadership is about inspiring, collaborating and creating results together – and that is our mission every day.”

blocks.heading: Jan Rasmussen
blocks.bodyHtml:
Operational control in Fleet Management Operational Control in a Fleet Management department plays a crucial role in ensuring the daily operation and efficiency of the company's fleet. The role requires structured work, problem solving and ongoing communication with IT Developer and management to ensure a smooth Fleet Management platform.
